newsitem.title: USA: Gaylord in merger talks with 2 companies.
newsitem.headline: Gaylord in merger talks with 2 companies.

text.p: Gaylord Companies Inc said Thursday it was in preliminary discussions with two private companies about a possible merger.
Gaylord President John Critser declined to give specifics other than that the prospective partners were engaged in multimedia product development and marketing.
"These talks are currently in the conceptual stages, and there is no assurance we will come to agreements that are mutually beneficial to each company," Critser said.
